283771483.description:
Vintage Promotional Wall Calendar Lot
The Travelers & Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance
Paper & Cardboard Ephemera, Circa 1950s
This estate collection features vintage 1950s promotional wall calendars and art prints issued by prominent American insurance firms, including The Travelers Insurance Company of Hartford, Connecticut, and The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company. Highly regarded for their high-quality lithographic reproductions, these corporate calendars showcased classic American artwork, including Currier & Ives historical lithographs and John James Audubon wildlife plates.
Items Included:
1953 The Travelers wall calendar featuring Currier & Ives prints such as "The Home of Washington, Mount Vernon, Va." and "Morning in the Woods"
1957 The Northwestern Mutual Life Insurance Company Centennial Anniversary calendar with Audubon "Mallard Duck" artwork
Standalone illustrated botanical art sheet featuring a detailed green oak tree
Multiple rolled calendar tubes and original postal shipping tubes housed in a cardboard storage box
Condition:
Paper shows vintage toning, edge curling, foxing, and age-related wear consistent with rolled storage. Outer paper sleeves and mailing tubes display tears, fraying, tape residue, and chipping. Prints retain clear details and legible typography. Hanging metal strips and eyelets present on calendars.

Description
: Explore the fascinating world of geology and paleontology with this comprehensive rock, mineral, and fossil collection set, perfect for collectors or educational use. The collection includes a sturdy plastic organizer box with red segmented trays, holding an impressive array of specimens. Visible varieties include rose quartz, citrine, amethyst, sodalite, aventurine, polished stones, and more.
Additionally, the set features 10 individually bagged fossils, such as trilobite, dinosaur bone, ammonite, brachiopod, petrified wood, shark tooth, coral, and other clearly labeled specimens, each with informational inserts describing their origins. This diverse assortment allows for hands-on study and display, making it ideal for beginners, hobbyists, classrooms, and anyone interested in earth science. The overall condition appears gently used, with all contents securely housed and ready for immediate use or gifting. Expand your collection or enhance learning with this well-organized and visually appealing selection
